title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
premise: Marseille, 1815. Young sailor Edmond Dantès comes home to marry Mercédès and become a captain, unaware that jealous rivals are plotting against him.

moments.title: Arrest at the betrothal feast
moments.happened: Framed by Danglars and Fernand as a Bonapartist agent, Edmond is arrested at his own betrothal feast.

moments.title: The Château d’If
moments.happened: To protect his own family, the prosecutor Villefort buries Edmond in an island prison without trial.
alternatives: Villefort gives him a fair trial

moments.title: The Abbé Faria
moments.happened: Edmond meets the old prisoner Faria, who educates him and tells him of a hidden treasure.

moments.title: The escape
moments.happened: Edmond takes Faria’s place in a burial sack and is thrown into the sea.
alternatives: Edmond is caught in the sack
Edmond takes Faria’s map but not his place

moments.title: The Count arrives in Paris
moments.happened: Rich and transformed, Edmond appears in Paris as the Count of Monte Cristo.
alternatives: Edmond returns to Marseille in peace
Edmond reveals himself to Mercédès at once

moments.title: Mercédès recognises him
moments.happened: Mercédès, who knew him all along, begs the Count to spare her son Albert in a duel.
alternatives: Mercédès tells Albert the truth first

moments.title: Too far
moments.happened: As Villefort’s family is destroyed, the Count begins to wonder if his revenge has gone too far.
